ignoreValues.reason: The --spring-* easings are the design system's spring physics (smooth and travel have zero bounce; snappy overshoots 0.2%), generated by scripts/spring-easing.mjs. Owner-required.
The square supplier-status marker is distinguished from the round status markers by shape, not color alone.
The mark assembly is the one sanctioned use of spring.lively (bounce 0.22): a real success moment at first run. docs/motion.md allows lively only for such moments.
The time wheel fades its edges with mask-image, which reads only alpha. #000 is the opaque mask stop and is never painted.
The website landing page uses display sizes for its hero and section headlines. They sit above the app type ramp on purpose and are not used in product UI.
